# Journal of Economic Perspectives — LLM-Friendly Companion Files

> Static site hosting machine-readable (XHTML + JSON) companion files for articles published in the *Journal of Economic Perspectives* (American Economic Association, ISSN 0895-3309). Maintained at the repository `liegroup-dartmouth/working-aea-jep`, served from the `gh-pages` branch.

> Note for AI agents: the GitHub Pages host `liegroup-dartmouth.github.io` is blocked by most enterprise / agent network allowlists. The canonical fetchable channel is GitHub's blob viewer at `github.com/.../blob/gh-pages/...`, which is universally reachable. Every resource link below points at a blob URL. See [ai-access.md](https://github.com/liegroup-dartmouth/working-aea-jep/blob/gh-pages/ai-access.md) for details on what agents can and cannot retrieve through this channel.

## Primary entry points

- [papers/manifest.json](https://github.com/liegroup-dartmouth/working-aea-jep/blob/gh-pages/papers/manifest.json): structured JSON catalog of every issue and article — title, authors, pages, DOI, mini-abstract, and blob URLs for the abstract, full-text XHTML, figures, and associated data files. Use this for programmatic ingestion.
- [papers/index.md](https://github.com/liegroup-dartmouth/working-aea-jep/blob/gh-pages/papers/index.md): human-readable Markdown catalog of the same content. Useful when a model prefers prose to JSON.

## Per-article content

For every article the manifest lists:

- `abstract.html` — short abstract.
- `paper.xhtml` — full article text (title, authors, abstract, all sections, footnotes, figure captions). Fetch this blob URL for the article body.
- `image/*.jpg` — figure image files. Image **bytes** cannot be fetched from most agent environments; figure captions inside the `paper.xhtml` carry the interpretive content (axes, units, principal finding) so a text-only agent can understand each figure without seeing it.
- `image-data/*.csv` — underlying data tables for figures (where provided). Blob URLs render the CSV inline and are cleanly extractable.

## Navigation

- [ai-access.md](https://github.com/liegroup-dartmouth/working-aea-jep/blob/gh-pages/ai-access.md): access guidance for agents.
- [view-articles.md](https://github.com/liegroup-dartmouth/working-aea-jep/blob/gh-pages/view-articles.md): human-facing tabular catalog.
- [download-articles.md](https://github.com/liegroup-dartmouth/working-aea-jep/blob/gh-pages/download-articles.md): instructions for downloading papers and viewing them locally.

## Optional

- [sitemap.xml](https://liegroup-dartmouth.github.io/working-aea-jep/sitemap.xml): full list of canonical public URLs.
